Hi Emily — great to hear, and thanks for sharing the budget file.

Short answer: we don't typically go as deep as 30% off list on hosted usage without an exec concession, but there are structured options to get close depending on commitment structure. Typical paths:

- Introductory pilot credit: up to 20% discount as a combination of upfront credit + volume tiers (no exec sign-off required).
- Executive concession: >20% requires deal desk + exec sign-off and is evaluated against commit / prepay / SLOs.

To move forward quickly, would you be able to confirm: 1) expected start date, 2) 12-month ARR commitment target ($), and 3) willingness to prepay or provide an MRR floor? If you can share the target ARR we can run the internal ask.

I've attached a one-page pilot proposal — I cc'ed Ben from sales to help with the economics side. If you're available Wednesday I'd propose a 30-minute call to finalize the MAP.

Best,

Team — forwarding ZenVera's ask. TL;DR: customer requests 30% off list for a 12-month committed pilot (~120M tokens/month). They indicated budget pain and need for board sign-off.

Why this matters: ZenVera is a compact but strategic health-tech partner; potential to expand into Dedicated in 18 months and to be a reference for clinical workloads. Proposed economics: 25% concession on hosted token rates in exchange for a 12-month $150k ARR commit with 3 months prepaid (or equivalent MRR floor). That sits over our standard non-exec threshold of 20%.

Asking for: executive authorization for a one-time concession up to 25% (deal_id ZEN-7231) subject to:
- 12-month contract with 3 months prepay OR guaranteed monthly minimum ($12,500/mo),
- legal to add a usage-based clawback if usage diverges by >40% from forecast,
- product to guarantee pilot capacity and regional routing in us-west.

Attachments: short deal summary (zenvera_deal_summary.pdf) with forecast, ARR math, and risk notes. Please advise approval (and any additional conditions) so I can revert to the buyer.
